# Michael Johnson
Chicago, IL | (312) 555-0198 | michael.johnson@example.com | github.com/mjohnson-dev

## PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 4 years of Python experience building web APIs and background-processing
systems. Comfortable across the request lifecycle: FastAPI services, PostgreSQL data models, and Celery
job queues. Eager to grow into a senior backend role.

## EXPERIENCE
### Loophole AnalyticsAug. 2021 – Present
Backend EngineerChicago, IL
- Built and maintained REST APIs in Python with FastAPI powering a customer-facing analytics
  dashboard (300+ endpoints).
- Implemented background jobs with Celery and Redis for scheduled report generation and email
  delivery.
- Modeled and optimized PostgreSQL schemas; added indexes and rewrote N+1 queries, halving
  p95 latency on key endpoints.
- Packaged services with Docker and set up docker-compose environments for local and staging.
- Wrote unit and integration tests (pytest), lifting service coverage from 40% to 78%.

### GreenTree SoftwareJul. 2020 – Jul. 2021
Junior Software DeveloperMilwaukee, WI
- Contributed Python scripts and small Flask endpoints for internal operations tooling.
- Assisted with Alembic database migrations and triaged production bugs.

## PROJECTS
### DevBoard - Self-hosted Kanban API2023
- Solo-built a FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend with JWT auth and a small React frontend; dockerized
  for one-command deploy.

## EDUCATION
### University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign2020
B.S. in Computer Science

## TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript
Frameworks: FastAPI, Flask, pytest
Data/Infra: PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Docker, Git
